completeness.why: Four sites now call the existing exported getScheduledAmount with their raw value (missing/number/range), so the whole dispatch is shared; the budget template's hand copy (halving the rounded sum) is untouched, which keeps the preserved inconsistency but leaves that site deciding locally instead of carrying it as an explicit rounding-mode argument.

interface.why: Reuses the existing getScheduledAmount(amount, inverse) without adding speculative options, but the template's different rounding is preserved only by leaving it out rather than made explicit as a named variation.

disguised_duplication.where: The removed ternaries are deleted and replaced with calls; the only remaining copy (schedule-template.ts runSchedule) is left verbatim, not reshaped.
